notes.title: Mini game update
notes.content: A small update to the game settings book, some changes in the program code for displaying the menu interface and some minor corrections!

notes.title: Mini update
notes.content:
Fixed saving volume of music and sounds
 Slight change to the landscape of the main table, patched holes in the relief.
 The water was replaced with a static texture, it was displayed only for the right eye, which led to discomfort.
 Replaced some heavy colliders that caused the game to freeze when touched.


We are starting work on historical battles, which will take a significant amount of time.

Enjoy your game and frequent victories!

notes.title: Warrior physics update
notes.content:
Updating the physical interactions between warriors has led to the elimination of freezes and game freezes in combat mode. No matter how many soldiers there are on the battlefield, it is now comfortable to play.

 The warriors code has been optimized, which led to significant CPU savings.
 Optimized castle colliders due to which there were significant FPS drawdowns when soldiers interacted with them.
 The lighting scheme of the battle scene has been improved.
 The overall performance of the game has been increased.


We continue to work on the game. Enjoy your game!

notes.title: Mini update of the VR King of Battle Cards
notes.content:
This mini update includes the following changes:

 Updated all English texts in the game.
All texts are translated by and for people. Enjoy the game!
 Fixed some bugs and inaccuracies we noticed in the game.
 Codes and textures have been optimized.
 Added a bonus bag with Crystal in the castle selection scene.
Sometimes when loading a scene, a bag with the game currency Crystal appears under the oak tree next to the Horror teleport. Do not forget to check the prize and top up the currency for faster card pumping. And also watch a mini horror movie, because it will change over time and become different.
